purpose: General rules for implementing plugin scripts (Python/Bash) and SKILL.md that do not depend on a specific plugin: language choice, tests, layout, temp files, references, fallbacks, versioning.
summary: Script language choice and dependency policy: standard library Python by default, Bash for external commands
Test requirements: mandatory for distributed .py, naming test_{module}.py, test directory matches skill name
No inline logic in SKILL.md; call independent scripts instead
Placement of scripts and docs: skill-specific vs plugin-wide, no direct reference to other skills internals
Temp files under .temp/<plugin>/<skill>/ written with the Write tool, session ID in file name
Distributed artifacts must not reference development-only docs
Only SKILL is the interface to other components; never call their scripts directly
Delete unused code; no deprecation markers
Do not use script parsers for AI-interpreted natural-language input
Do not write fallbacks reflexively; and do not edit version files in ordinary work
tasks: Implementing plugin Python or Bash scripts
Deciding where to place scripts and docs
Considering adding a fallback to error handling
Reviewing changes that touch version files
title: プラグイン実装ガイドライン
